strategy: Create one reusable component rather than separate code for every variant.

htmlCss.layout: Translate HORIZONTAL/VERTICAL layout modes to flexbox and GRID to CSS grid.

react.propModel: Use implementation.api.properties as the public props contract.
react.variants: Resolve implementation.variants against props and apply the matching render/layout data.

instructions: Use this file as the primary LLM input for implementing this component.
Read AGENTS.md first for bundle-level rules and file selection.
Build a reusable component API from implementation.api and implementation.variants.
Prefer related tokens and styles when bindings exist, then fall back to literal render values.
Use render.variants for normalized boxes, visual styling, text, SVG paths, and states.
Open the full render contract only for vector networks or other fidelity details intentionally omitted here.
limitations: Image paint binaries are embedded when available and recorded as asset references otherwise.
Font files are not embedded. Renderers should use installed fonts or project fallbacks.
Figma-specific effects, blend modes, and text layout may require renderer-specific approximation.
